messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from the INC-834 RCA — pasted action list below. Can folks confirm ownership + firm due dates by EOD so we can close the loop? Pls reply with owner + due.

ben: ack. I'll take action A2 (increase model cache TTL + add perf monitor). due 2026-03-20.

maria: taking A5 (runbook update + rollback steps). due 2026-03-18. will add a quick smoke check. @ops-bot please open ticket.

alpha_oncall: flagging A4 (canary rollout policy) — this looks infra-heavy. Can platform team own? @ben can you coordinate with eng-platform?

ben: ok I can coordinate with eng-platform and own the integration work. setting due 2026-03-22.

sara: thanks. @maria when you update the runbook can you include a 1-line smoke test and the rollback command?

maria: yes. sample smoke command I'll add:
```
curl -fsS https://health.redwood.example/_canary | grep -i OK
```

alpha_oncall: also, A7 (upstream pkg update) is blocked on vendor patch. @sara any vendor ETA?

sara: vendor expects a patch next week (tentative). marking A7 status=blocked, owner=platform-team, tentative due=2026-03-25.

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem actions without a confirmed owner in 48h will be auto-assigned to the oncall rotation.

ben: added owner notes and created ticket INC-834-A2 (https://issues.redwood/INC-834-A2).

maria: created INC-834-A5 for runbook updates.

sara: perfect. final ask — react with :eyes: when you've updated the doc/ticket so I can compile the closure list.

ben: :eyes:

maria: :eyes:

alpha_oncall: :thumbsup:

sara: thanks all — I'll fold these into the postmortem and send the closure note tomorrow.
